gaps.explanation: Detail records the p4 governmental funds statement 'Transfers in(out)' row gross per fund: General (328,157) + Debt Service (6,378) = 334,535 out, and Capital Projects 115,347 + Cemetery 7,821 + Non major Funds 166,717 = 289,885 in. The statement's Total column prints the net (44,650) (the transfer to Water/Sewer, p6 Transfers in (out) 44,650). 334,535 - 289,885 = 44,650; the gap of -289,885 is exactly the intra-governmental transfers in. Gross vs net only; no error.

The business-type statement total is 430,200 = p6 Operating revenue 358,520 (accrual) + American Rescue Plan Act 71,680 (p6 Other income). The Water/Sewer detail comes from the p10 cash-basis budget schedule: Receipts 'Water and sewer' 348,370 (= p7 Cash received from customers). The schedule prints the ARPA 71,680 under Other Financing Sources (in detail as section 'other financing'), not under receipts. Gap 81,830 = 71,680 (ARPA classified as other financing on p10) + 10,150 (accrual vs cash: p8 increase in accounts receivable (10,150); 358,520 - 348,370 = 10,150). Both printed amounts are correct on their own basis.

The statement total 421,482 (p2) = p6 Total operating expenses 393,020 + Interest expense 28,462 (accrual, includes Depreciation 79,787). The p10 cash-basis budget schedule prints Total disbursements 436,114 = Water and sewer 313,083 + Capital outlay 19,569 + Principal 75,000 + Interest 28,462. Arithmetic: 421,482 + capital outlay 19,569 + principal 75,000 - depreciation 79,787 - 150 (cash vs accrual operating payments: 393,020 - 79,787 = 313,233 vs 313,083) = 436,114. Gap -14,632 = -(19,569 + 75,000 - 79,787 - 150). Different basis (cash budget schedule vs accrual statement).
